ai_summary: AMJ Land Holdings Limited has announced a leadership reshuffle, with Mr. Surendra Kumar Bansal resigning as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) for "personal reasons" but retaining his position as a Whole-time Director. Ms. Megha Goel, an internal candidate with over 10 years of experience, has been appointed as the new CFO, effective August 2, 2026, alongside Mr. Sahil Dudani as the new Company Secretary & Compliance Officer. These changes suggest a managed transition rather than an abrupt departure, with the former CFO's continued presence mitigating any potential instability.
